breaks.why: The merge commit turns DocumentInterpreter.ts (static parse at base line 1560) into an empty blob, while createDocumentParseRobotRecord still imports DocumentInterpreter from it and calls DocumentInterpreter.parse at line 27; the caller is reached from the POST /recordings/document-parse handler in routes/storage.ts. An empty file exports nothing, so the import doesn't type-check and the call has no function to run.

fix.why: 9262631 "fix: null byte corruption", pushed to develop 55 minutes after the merge, restores DocumentInterpreter.ts (0 to 1,677 lines) with export class DocumentInterpreter and static parse again; its message names the corruption, so the restore is the intended fix, not a side effect.
